episodes.synopsis: Chaos at home, Sho Yamato races to the X-Zone. Black smoke transports him and rival Gabu to a strange new world. They're arrested for illegal biking.
episodes.title: This Is An MTB Battle! Kore ga MTB BATTLE da!

episodes.synopsis: Sho and his friends are lost in a treacherous world. Facing danger and competition, they must use their mountain biking skills to escape. Will they find their way home?
episodes.title: Big Escape! Sand Dune Battle Daidassou! Sakyuu no tatakai

episodes.synopsis: Sho and his friends battle Gabu's team in the treacherous X-Zone. Can they overcome this setback and emerge stronger?
episodes.title: Crash! The First Defeat? Shougeki! Hajimete no haiboku?

episodes.synopsis: Sho's prized MTB, Flame Kaiser, is stolen. He must race against skilled rivals, using his bike skills and strategy, to reclaim it and win.
episodes.title: Take Back! My MTB! Torimodose! Ore no MTB!

episodes.synopsis: Sho and his friends face a volcanic race, battling tough terrain and rivals. Can their MTB skills and teamwork conquer the dangerous obstacles and win?
episodes.title: Fiery Volcano Battle!! Honoo no kazan no BATTLE!!

episodes.synopsis: Sho and his friends face the Hyper Brain team in a thrilling MTB race. Can Sho use his skills and tactics to outpace their rivals and claim victory?
episodes.title: A High-Tech Group's Challenge HIGH-TECH shuudan no chousen

episodes.synopsis: Sho and his friends battle rivals in the MTB Cemetery, a graveyard of abandoned bikes with treacherous terrain. Can they overcome the obstacles and conquer the challenge?
episodes.title: Ouch! MTB's Graveyard Auu! MTB no hakaba

episodes.synopsis: The legendary Neptune bike holds secrets. A team faces rivals for its power. Can Sho master it and win?
episodes.title: Enter Neptune! NEPTUNE toujou!

episodes.synopsis: Sho Yamato and his team unveil the Mask Rider's secret identity, uncovering the motive behind their actions. Can they adapt their strategy to defeat this growing threat?
episodes.title: The Identity Of The Masked Boy Kamen shounen no shoutai

episodes.synopsis: Sho's toughest MTB race yet pits them against a rival with unmatched skill and a powerful bike. Can Sho and their team rise to the challenge?
episodes.title: The Strongest Rival Appears!

episodes.synopsis: Sho races aboard a massive ship, navigating narrow paths, and shifting terrain. Can Sho outmanoeuvre his opponents and claim victory in this challenging race?
episodes.title: Onboard Battle! Team ST's Trap

episodes.synopsis: Sho Yamato's dream of becoming the best rider is on the line. Facing tough rivals, his fierce determination will be tested. Can he win the thrilling race?
episodes.title: The Admired Celeb Resort City

episodes.synopsis: Sho Yamato and his friends navigate a treacherous school, dodging obstacles and battling skilled riders. Can Sho adapt to this unique race and claim victory?
episodes.title: School Battle! Explosion, Idaten Cross!

episodes.synopsis: In a mining town, children meet siblings Saya and her brother. Saya claims her brother can defeat Flame Kaizer, but his strange behavior hints at a hidden secret.
episodes.title: The Man Who Beat Flame Kaiser?

episodes.synopsis: Makoto arrives at the Aqua Palace, destined to be the prince's bride. But he holds a secret - he's Team ST. Her mission: uncover his truth. Will she succeed?
episodes.title: The Prince of MTB

episodes.synopsis: A month-long journey to X City leaves the kids disheartened. A broken trailer and Makoto's quitting spark a heated battle. Who will prevail?
episodes.title: Struggle In The Rain, Awakened Neptune

episodes.synopsis: Yuki's shortcut to X-City plunges them into a demon-haunted cavern. As fear grips Sho and his friends, a mysterious figure emerges. Can they survive the darkness?
episodes.title: Finally Understand! Team ST's Secret

episodes.synopsis: Shido doubts Makoto's Neptune awakening. To travel to X City, Sho and Makoto must pass a tough test. Will they succeed?
episodes.title: A New Assassin! The Test's Battle Between Siblings

episodes.synopsis: Despite passing the test, Shido still calls Sho immature, fuelling Sho's frustration. They agree to settle the score with an Idaten Battle. Who will win the battle?
episodes.title: Showdown! Flame Kaiser VS. Thunder Emperor

episodes.synopsis: Sho's battle with Shido is interrupted by Koei's ninja skills, sending Shido falling. Sho trains fiercely, blindfolded, to prepare for the final showdown against Koei. Can he win?
episodes.title: Formidable Opponent! Ninja Rider Kokage

episodes.synopsis: Reaching X-City's gate, the kids are denied entry. Facing the Guardian Brothers, they must navigate a treacherous battle course. Can they overcome the obstacles and gain access?
episodes.title: X City's Gate Guardians

episodes.synopsis: X City falls under the tyrannical grip of Team Shark Tooth. Sho, fueled by righteous anger, challenges their leader, Tiger Jiro, to an Idaten Battle. Will justice prevail?
episodes.title: Arrival! X City

episodes.synopsis: Sho arrives in X-City just as the I Daten tournament kicks off. The prize: 7 Gold Emblems. Can she win and return home a champion?
episodes.title: The Idaten Battle Tournament Begins!

episodes.synopsis: Sho is ready for the tournament, but his first opponent is Makoto. Will he face his friend in a duel? Who will take the title?
episodes.title: Crash! Flame Kaiser VS. Neptune

episodes.synopsis: The B Block heats up with Samejima Taiga, Gen, Arthur, and more battling for supremacy. Who will emerge victorious in this fierce clash?
episodes.title: Hammerhead! The 6th Idaten Bike

episodes.synopsis: Sho and his friends fight for his return home in an epic tournament. But what is Keoichi's secret weapon?
episodes.title: Certain Kill! Shido Special

episodes.synopsis: Sho gets a dream about his father who encourages him to focus on the finals. Furthermore, Gabu fires Taiga after his defeat. Will this bring repurcussions to the tournament?
episodes.title: Battle! Hammerhead VS. Aero Scissors!

episodes.synopsis: Gabu manipulates the competition to ensure Koei's victory, but Koei, disillusioned by the deceit, confronts him. Will Koei betray his principles for success?
episodes.title: The Final Showdown's Conspiracy

episodes.synopsis: Gabu executes his devious plan and gets Kiku kidnapped. He tries to use her to gain advantage over Koei. Will Sho and his friends be able to rescue Kiku and protect her?
episodes.title: Final Battle! Who Will Be The Victor?

episodes.synopsis: Sho and friends bask in victory, but Gabu has a trick up his sleeve. What mischievous scheme is he plotting?
episodes.title: Charge! X Tower

episodes.synopsis: Sho wins the Idaten Battle, but Gabu steals the emblems. As Sho battles Gabu, the Four Kings take away the emblems. Will show be able to retrieve back what is rightfully his?
episodes.title: Decisive Battle! Flame Kaiser VS. Bloody Fang

episodes.synopsis: While wandering around in the tower, Sho catches a glimpse of Imperial X. Meanwhile Gabu is furious at his defeat. Will he take another hasty step out of anger?
episodes.title: Farewell X Zone

episodes.synopsis: Sho's dream of Miss Yuki and his father's secret is shattered by a tide. He desperately tries to convince Ayumu and his mom about the X-Zone's existence.
episodes.title: A New, Formidable Enemy

episodes.synopsis: Sho and his friends crave a return to X Zone, but their path remains unclear. A bike repair sparks conflict, putting their mission in jeopardy.
episodes.title: To X Zone Again!

episodes.synopsis: After a tremendous battle with some mysterious people, Sho and his friends find clues about his dad's disappearance. Will they find out the truth?
episodes.title: Shock! Sho's Father Is Alive

episodes.synopsis: Sho and his friends chase Team X to Imperial Island to retrieve the stolen Imperial X. Ayumu's kidnapping complicates their mission. Can Sho rescue his friend and reclaim the X?
episodes.title: Roar! Imperial Dragon!!

episodes.synopsis: Sho, victorious in Massaji, continues his quest. But a new challenge awaits: Kyoichi's Team X. Count Freddy, under orders, must test Sho's strength - but can he win?
episodes.title: The Feared Dark Emblem

episodes.synopsis: On their journey to Imperial Island, Sho and Hosuke encounter Sayji and Mantaro. A cryptic letter from Gabu throws their plans into question.
episodes.title: Gabu's Allure, Flame Kaiser's In A Pinch!

episodes.synopsis: Sho and friends blindly search Imperial Island for Team X's hidden HQ. Elsewhere, Koei secretly visits his ill sister, warning her to conceal their sibling bond from Team X.
episodes.title: Climax! Imperial Dragon VS. Aero Scissors Hakunetsu!

episodes.synopsis: Sho and his friends face perils in X-Zone's Nameless Forest, determined to reach Imperial Island. But danger lurks, testing their resolve. Will they make it?
episodes.title: The Nameless Forest's Vermin

episodes.synopsis: Makoto and Sho unite their Idaten Bikes for an epic "Idaten Cross," powering through a waterfall to advance in their race. Can their combined strength propel them to victory?
episodes.title: Arthur's Challenge!

episodes.synopsis: Sho, Makoto, and Arthur jump across sea pillars to reach Imperial Island, overcoming the final challenge in their journey. Will they successfully complete their adventure?
episodes.title: Idaten Bike's Big Gathering!

episodes.synopsis: Shaw and Keoichi face off in a high-stakes duel that tests their deepest convictions. As their souls clash, who will emerge victorious in this ultimate battle for supremacy?
episodes.title: Sho VS. Shido! Battle Of Life Or Death!

episodes.synopsis: Imperial X reveals its terrifying true form, plunging the world into chaos and fear. What dark secrets lie behind this revelation?
episodes.title: Shocking Reunion! Imperial X Appears

episodes.synopsis: A new island rises from the depths, shaking the world's foundations and spreading panic. As the landscape shifts, can the heroes prevent the impending disaster?
episodes.title: The Second Island Appears! The Beginning Of The World's Collapse

episodes.synopsis: Takeshi's dark power threatens to engulf X-Zone. Can anyone stop the escalating chaos before it consumes everything?
episodes.title: Charge! Team X VS. Imperial Dragon Daishuugeki!

episodes.synopsis: Sho faces ultimate tests in legendary training grounds, pushing him to his limits. Will he emerge stronger or fall?
episodes.title: The Legendary Training Grounds, Sho's Special Training!

episodes.synopsis: Sho discovers a miracle power, unleashing a new secret move with explosive force. As his opponents are caught off guard, can Sho master this power in time to secure victory?
episodes.title: The Miracle Power!

episodes.synopsis: Gabu watches Kyoichi, Sho, and Makoto perform, a knowing smile on his face. He wonders if Sho can overcome the challenge of facing Neptune.
episodes.title: Flame Kaiser Vs Imperial X!

episodes.synopsis: Sho and his friends face unexpected obstacles as they journey to mysterious Imperial Island. Will they overcome the challenges and reach their destination?
episodes.title: he Battle for Imperial Island!

episodes.synopsis: Imperial Island hangs in the balance as Sho and his friends face their ultimate test. Destiny awaits, but will they rise to the challenge?
episodes.title: The Battle of Destiny,The Final Battle!

episodes.synopsis: The fate of X-Zone rests on Sho and his friends' shoulders as they unlock a new power to restore balance. Time is running out.
episodes.title: Awakening the World
